step1_analysis.description: A differential amplifier with an LC tuned load and source-follower output buffers, used to amplify and buffer the local oscillator (LO) signal at 17 GHz.

paper_reference.title: A 17.1–17.3-GHz Image-Reject Downconverter Subharmonic With Phase-Tunable LO Using 3 Injection Locking

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the buffer stage

sky130_expected.calculation: 4 current branches (bias, diff pair tail, 2x EF tails). Vbias=0.75V, Vth=0.42V, Rdeg=50 ohm -> I_branch ~ 3mA. Total I ~ 12mA. Power = 1.8V * 12mA = 21.6mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on exact Vth and Rdeg, but expected to be a fraction of the total receiver power.

voltage_gain.description: Differential voltage gain at the resonant frequency (17 GHz)

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 2*Id/Vov ~ 15mS. Rload = 200 ohm. Gain = gm * Rload * EF_gain = 15m * 200 * 0.8 = 2.4 V/V = 7.6 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain is determined by the LC tank's parallel resistance at resonance and the diff pair transconductance.

sky130_expected.calculation: f = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L * C)). With L=1.75nH and C_parasitic+C_load ~ 50fF, f ~ 17 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The circuit is designed to operate at the LO frequency of 17 GHz.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain profile, and transient output swing of the 17GHz tuned LO buffer.
